verdicts.reason: A and B look the same: each is the portrait layout shrunk into a narrow column in the middle of a wide, short strip, with the dark logo bar squeezed into a thin band at the top. The six-line headline, body copy and legal line are a few pixels tall and unreadable, the logo can't be made out, and the only legible element is the orange CTA pill. The cream space on both sides is dead. Neither one rearranges the design into a left-to-right banner, so both are unusable.
